content: General Functions The following general functions are defined: • if(condition, a, b) returns a if condition evaluates to true , b if condition evaluates to false , returns undefined in all other cases. 136 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 • default(a,d) returns a if a is defined, otherwise it returns d .
